title: Oneiro's strategist, dry-run on pursuit #27's snapshot, proposes a Slate move
why: Until the strategist knows agents can make video, pursuits never plan it. Oneiro's self-want (chain #64 in its engine) adds that line; after it lands, the strategist's dry run on pursuit #27 has to propose at least one move that uses Slate.
prompt: Built at run time: the strategist's system prompt from agents.js, then the message strategize() composes from pursuit #27's snapshot.

precondition.summary: Oneiro's self-want (chain #64) has landed: the strategist's capability list names Slate, and pursuit #27's snapshot is on disk.

all.why: chain #64 adds a video line naming Slate to the strategist's capability list
pursuit #27's snapshot, which the dry run reads

info.why: chain #64's own status in the engine, for the record

expect.why: at least one of its moves uses Slate

notes: Pending until the precondition holds. The dry run is one answer-only model call (no shell, no browser, no tools), so it can't act on anything.
